# What these blocks do
These purple blocks show or make something you can see and hear on the IoT kit.

# display text
Shows a word or a number on the small display. You can drop a sensor block inside to show a live reading.

# set LED on and set LED off
Turns the LED on or off. Choose the LED port in the drop-down. You can also set the LED colour on kits with a colour LED.

# buzzer beep for seconds
Sounds the buzzer for the number of seconds you type. Keep beeps short so they are not annoying.

# clear display
Wipes the display so old text does not stay on the screen.
